Name: Double integrals/Dubbelintegraler
Basic relationship:
The limit of the sum of inscribed or circumscribed prisms with base $math{\D A = \D x \D y} equals the volume under the surface $math{z = f(x,y)} and is given by the double integral between $math{(x_1, x_2)} and $math{(y_1, y_2)} [Image]

$math{lim{n->\infty, \S{i=1, n, f(x_i, y_i)*\D A_i}} = int2{D, f(x, y)dxdy} = int{x_1, x_2, int{y_1, y_2, f(x,y) dy} dx}}

TRIPLE INTEGRALS/Trippelintegraler
Basic relationship:
Triple integrals are three-dimensional extensions of double integrals defined in analogous fashion [Image]

$math{lim{n->\inf, \S{i=1, n, f(x_i, y_i, z_i)*\D V_i} = int{x_1, x_2, int{y_1, y_2, int{z_1, z_2, f(x,y,z) dz} dy} dx}}
